raw.specification_text:
Scheme Name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
Target Classes: Class 9, Class 10
Academic Requirement: Studying as a regular, full-time student in Class 9 or Class 10 in a government or government-recognized school.
School Type Requirement: Government or recognized private schools.
Annual Income Ceiling: Rs. 250000
Selection Mode: Direct / Merit
Financial Assistance: Includes maintenance allowance (₹500/month for day scholars, ₹800/month for hostellers), annual book grant of ₹1,000, and disability allowances (braille/escort/reader allowances up to ₹4,000/yr). - Rs. 10000 per annum
Registration Requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
raw.faq_text:
Q: Who can apply for Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities?
A: Eligible students studying in Class 9, Class 10.
Q: What is the official portal?
A: https://scholarships.gov.in
Q: Is OTR required for AY 2026-27?
A: Yes, One Time Registration is mandatory on National Scholarship Portal.

eligibility_summary.disability_requirement: Minimum 40% disability certified by competent medical authority with a valid UDID / Disability Certificate.
eligibility_summary.academic_requirement: Studying as a regular, full-time student in Class 9 or Class 10 in a government or government-recognized school.

benefits_summary.details: Includes maintenance allowance (₹500/month for day scholars, ₹800/month for hostellers), annual book grant of ₹1,000, and disability allowances (braille/escort/reader allowances up to ₹4,000/yr).

raw.inclusion_rationale: Critical accessibility and financial inclusion scheme for disabled students completing secondary education in Class 9 and 10.
